# Social Provider Matrix

<!-- GENERATED by tools/generate-docs.mts — run `pnpm docs:generate`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Capabilities reflect current official platform documentation and the fact that this
product **does not ask influencers to authorize their accounts** (no creator OAuth),
so several profile-sync capabilities are authorization-dependent and the product leans
on strong manual fallbacks + official content embeds. A manual fallback ALWAYS exists.

Legend: `YES` always · `YES_WITH_API` needs the official API credential ·
`CONDITIONAL` depends on account type/eligibility · `AUTHORIZATION_DEPENDENT`
needs creator/app OAuth we don't perform · `MANUAL` manual only · `NO` unsupported.

| Platform | Profile Lookup | Follower Sync | Content Lookup | Content Embed | Content Metrics | Availability | Creator Auth | App Auth | Manual Fallback |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| Instagram | CONDITIONAL | CONDITIONAL | CONDITIONAL | YES | CONDITIONAL | YES | No | Yes | Yes |
| TikTok | AUTHORIZATION_DEPENDENT | AUTHORIZATION_DEPENDENT | AUTHORIZATION_DEPENDENT | YES | AUTHORIZATION_DEPENDENT | YES | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| YouTube | YES_WITH_API | YES_WITH_API | YES_WITH_API | YES | YES_WITH_API | YES | No | No | Yes |
| Snapchat | MANUAL | MANUAL | MANUAL | NO | MANUAL | CONDITIONAL | No | No | Yes |
| X | YES_WITH_API | YES_WITH_API | CONDITIONAL | YES | CONDITIONAL | YES | No | Yes | Yes |

## Notes & limitations

### Instagram

Instagram Graph API only exposes data for eligible Professional (Business/Creator) accounts connected through Meta. Personal accounts are manual-only. Content uses the official Instagram embed.

### TikTok

TikTok profile & video statistics require creator OAuth (Login Kit / Display API), which this product does not perform. Public video embedding is supported via the official TikTok embed. Profiles are manual.

### YouTube

YouTube Data API v3 provides public channel & video statistics with an API key. Embeds use the official privacy-enhanced player.

### Snapchat

Snapchat has no public profile/content API for third-party creator data. The product treats Snapchat as manual/URL-based; availability is a best-effort link check only.

### X

X API v2 (bearer token) can read public profile & tweet data subject to plan limits. Public metrics availability depends on the access tier. Embeds use the official tweet iframe.
